hard_earned_lessons_do_not_forget: Worktree isolation does NOT always isolate file writes — agents' Edit/Write target absolute paths and can leak into main worktree.
Bash CWD drifts when you cd into worktrees during inspection; re-orient before each git commit/push.
PowerShell ExecutionPolicy blocks -File invocations on Strix; use -ExecutionPolicy Bypass.
Activate.ps1 also hits ExecutionPolicy; call .venv\Scripts\python.exe directly.
scp -r nests into existing remote dirs; use ./dir/. trailing-merge idiom OR install rsync (Scoop dropped rsync; Choco needs admin).
Triton-Windows AMD backend has bf16-affine-scan codegen bug on gfx1151; force DELTA_MEM_SCAN_IMPL=torch.
locomo_eval.py reuses existing output JSONs; rename to *.STALE.json before re-running.
ssh strix from msys2/Git-Bash fails with libcrypto error; tools/strix_ssh.py picks native Windows OpenSSH automatically.
rocm-smi is NOT bundled with ROCm-on-Windows 7.1; use python -c 'import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())' as the GPU-ready gate.
NF4 + OSCAR INT2 compound badly (base collapse). NF4 + bf16 KV is fine. Don't stack NF4 with OSCAR until rotations are re-calibrated against NF4 statistics.
delta-mem's adapter is 4.9 M trainable params (252 tensors), much smaller than my prior 50 M estimate.
gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={use_reentrant: True} is NON-NEGOTIABLE for delta-mem training (Triton scan saved_tensors).
EpiCache is a parallel inference pipeline NOT a Cache subclass — wiring needs 200-350 LOC of pipeline bridging.
